title: Charging the Protection Fee on a Keyturn Guest Protection Plan Election
content:
A Keyturn Guest Protection Plan election that carries cover for a trip carries a protection fee for it, and
that fee is raised against the election as a protection line of its own.

The protection fee for a trip is fixed only once the election has left the quoted state and carries the number of days of cover the level will run for.

## Posting the fee

The desk posts the fee with `post_protection_fee_513639f7`, which the desk unlocks and calls itself. The line it
writes stands on the election for the initial stretch of the trip, carrying the fee, the days of cover it was
priced on and the day the line was written, and the money is added to the protection fee the guest owes on that
election. The guest can afterwards see the fee standing against their cover for the trip.

## The values the call carries

| Value | What it is |
|---|---|
| `election_id` | The reference number of the protection election the fee is charged to, read from the guest's protection election record |
| `customer_id` | The member reference number of the guest being charged, read from the member profile lookup |
| `booking_id` | The booking reference number of the trip the protection covers, read from the protection election record or from the trip booking record |
| `fee_amount` | The protection fee charged for the trip, in USD to 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent and never rounded anywhere but at the end, always a positive amount |
| `days_covered` | How many days of cover the fee was priced on, in whole days, as a positive integer with no fraction |

## What comes back

A one-line confirmation naming the reference number of the protection line just written, the fee in USD to 2
decimal places, and the whole number of days it was priced on. The line appearing in that confirmation is what
shows the protection fee now stands on that election.
